newsitem.title: USA: CBOT says overnight Project A volume sets record.
newsitem.headline: CBOT says overnight Project A volume sets record.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said on Thursday that volume during the overnight Project A session for Wednesday reached a record 17,761 contracts.
That surpassed the previous overnight volume record of 14,918 contracts set on September 3, the CBOT said.
The new record comprised 17,169 financial and 592 agricultural contracts, the CBOT said.
Project A is the CBOT's after-hours electronic order entry and matching system. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
